verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device model runtime SDK and CLI, so loading GGUF-packaged models is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions GGUF or any user-loadable model file format. The docs cover model downloads and generation APIs, and one community comment mentions a llama.cpp fallback, but neither says GGUF files can be loaded, so no credit can be given.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
